Bihar Police CSBC Driver Constable DET Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Central Selection Board of Constable (CSBC) will release the DET Admit Card for the post of Driver Constables. This recruitment was released for 4361 posts. Applications for the Bihar Police CSBC Driver Constable Recruitment 2025 were accepted from July 21, 2025, to August 20, 2025. The PET examination was held on 12 March 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their Bihar Police CSBC Driver Constable DET Admit Card 2026 Soon from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 17 July 2025
  • Application Start Date : 21 July 2025
  • Last Date : 20 August 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 August 2025
  • Exam Date : 10 December 2025
  • Exam City Details : 25 November 2025
  • Admit Card : 03 December 2025
  • Result : 30 December 2025
  • PET Exam Date Start : 12 March 2026
  • PET Admit Card : 15 February 2026
  • PET Result Available : 28 April 2026
  • DET Admit Card : 10 August 2026 Available Soon

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, EBC, BC : Rs. 675/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 180/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
